title: RmDamageNumbers
description: A client-side mod to toggle the visibility of floating damage indicators.
body:
## RmDamageNumbers - Damage Indicator Toggle Mod

**RmDamageNumbers** is a lightweight client-side Minecraft mod that gives players complete control over floating damage indicators in their game.

## 🌟 Core Features
- Provides a seamless way to toggle floating damage numbers on and off in real-time
- Default toggle key is **Z**, but can be remapped through Minecraft's standard keybinding options
- Displays clear status messages when toggling indicators on/off
- Prevents both spawning and rendering of text display entities when disabled

If the server you play on is using MythicMobs plugin this mod will most likely work for your use case if the damage numbers are being generated by Mythic plugins.

I got the inspiration to make this mod from a server I play on called DungeonCraft.

If you want to check it out the ip is DungeonCraft.co.
